sections.name: File setup, fmt
sections.title: Browser marker and time formatting
sections.what: Marks the file as browser code, brings in React helpers and the data type, and defines a formatter that shows a date and time in UTC to the minute.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps timestamps consistent and readable.
sections.watch_out: The formatter throws on an invalid time string, so bad data can crash the drawer.

sections.name: ReceiptLabels, EN, day
sections.title: Default English labels and date helper
sections.what: Holds the default English words for each drawer label, and a helper that shows only the date.
sections.why: Likely reason: provides default text when the parent passes no labels. The code does not show other languages.
sections.watch_out: Any new label must be added to the label type and the defaults, or it will be missing.

sections.name: Receipt
sections.title: Receipt button and drawer
sections.what: Renders the button with the source label, the drawer with its facts, and a close button. Tracks whether the drawer is open, closes it on Escape, and returns focus to the button.
sections.why: Likely reason: the drawer is hidden until asked for, and returning focus helps keyboard users.
sections.watch_out: Escape works only when focus is inside the receipt, so a user who has moved focus elsewhere cannot close it that way.

summary: A button that opens a drawer showing where a number came from: its source, data class, observed or match date, and attribution.
purpose: Lets a user check the origin of any figure, which supports trust in the numbers shown.
why: The comment calls it the receipt drawer on a number, with a button that opens it and Escape that closes it.
how: Shows the source as a button. Clicking toggles a drawer. The drawer lists source, class and time. For replayed data it adds a note that times are a replay clock, and it adds attribution and any extra details when given. Escape or the Close button hides it and returns focus to the button.
inputs: receipt (source id, source class, observed time, clock type), optional attribution, details, labels and children.
outputs: An interactive element on screen. Nothing is stored.
risks: An empty or invalid timestamp makes the date formatting throw, which can break the page. Labels default to English only.
debug: If the page errors, check the observed time value. If the drawer does not open, check the open state and the hidden attribute.
